annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The content links a funded smart-contract and flashloan/arbitrage workflow to claimed cryptocurrency profits. It instructs viewers to deploy or fund the contract and call the flashloan function, and the speaker reports a claimed seven-times result. The content explicitly frames the mechanism as an attack and loophole, including an arbitrage attack against AAVE and a purported loophole used in connection with the claimed benefit. This supports a rule or market-mechanism bypass secondary to the funded-contract returns workflow; it does not independently prove successful exploitation.
